title: C1 Milestone 8: Final Exam
completion_message: ¡MAGNÍFICO! ¡Has completado oficialmente el nivel C1 de Inglés Corporativo! Tu dominio abarca desde complejas inversiones gramaticales y cleft sentences hasta el lenguaje estratégico de las juntas directivas. Tienes el nivel lingüístico de un líder global. ¡El mundo corporativo es tuyo!

parts.visual:
¡Bienvenido al Examen Final de C1! 
En este último desafío pondrás a prueba todo lo aprendido en el Nivel C1. 

Gramática Avanzada: 
- Mixed Conditionals (If I had bought Bitcoin, I would be rich). 
- Inversion for Emphasis (Never have I seen...). 
- Advanced Cleft Sentences (What we need is... / It was the CEO who...). 
- Participle Clauses (Having signed the deal, we celebrated). 
- The Subjunctive (It is crucial that he resign).
parts.audio: Welcome to the Grand C1 Final Exam! In this ultimate challenge, you will test everything you have learned in the C1 Level. We will review Advanced Grammar, including Mixed Conditionals, Inversion for Emphasis, Advanced Cleft Sentences, Participle Clauses, and the Subjunctive mood.

parts.visual:
Vocabulario Corporativo C1: 
- Finanzas, Fusiones y Adquisiciones (M&A, hostile takeover, IPO). 
- Estrategia (Pivot, benchmark, synergy). 
- Legal (Breach of contract, NDA, liability). 
- Crisis y PR (Damage control, whistleblower). 
- Idioms y Gobierno Corporativo (Cash cow, Board of Directors, Fiduciary duty). 

¡Demuestra que tienes la fluidez nativa de un alto ejecutivo!
parts.audio: We will also test C1 Corporate Vocabulary. Topics include Finance, Mergers and Acquisitions, Strategy, Legal English, Crisis Management, PR, Advanced Idioms, and Corporate Governance. Prove that you have the native-like fluency of a top executive! Let's begin the final exam.

stages.title: C1 Final Certification Test
stages.description: Demuestra tu dominio absoluto del inglés corporativo nivel C1.

questions.question: Normal: I have never faced such a crisis. -> Inversion: Never ____ such a crisis.
questions.explanation: Inversión para dar énfasis: Never have I faced.

questions.question: If we ____ the competitor last year, we would be the market leaders today.
questions.explanation: Mixed Conditional (Pasado irreal -> Presente irreal): If we had bought.

questions.question: Normal: I only want a chance to present my idea. -> Cleft: ____ I want is a chance to present my idea.
It is absolutely essential that the CFO ____ the financial report by tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Subjunctive: that the CFO sign (forma base).

questions.question: ____ completed the audit, the accountants left the office.
questions.explanation: Participle Clause de pasado: Having completed.

questions.question: The company's most profitable product, which requires little investment, is its ____ cow.
The Board of Directors fired him because he breached his ____ duty to the shareholders.
The combination of two companies to create greater value than they would separately is called ____.
If you violate the terms of the NDA, we will sue you for ____ of contract.
questions.explanation: Breach of contract = incumplimiento de contrato.

questions.question: Due to the scandal, the PR team immediately went into ____ control.
Normal: People believe that the CEO stole the funds. -> Passive: The CEO is believed ____ the funds.
questions.explanation: Reporting passive (acción pasada): to have stolen.

questions.question: To start selling shares to the public for the first time is an ____ (Initial Public Offering).
Our competitor launched a ____ takeover by buying shares directly from the shareholders.
If I ____ you, I would accept the golden parachute and leave.
questions.explanation: Second conditional con to be: If I were you.

questions.question: Normal: The lack of cash flow caused the bankruptcy. -> Wh-Cleft: ____ caused the bankruptcy was the lack of cash flow.
We need to ____ the market if we want to establish a monopoly. (Acaparar).
The employee who reported the illegal accounting practices to the media is a ____.
I ____ going to attend the meeting, but my flight was cancelled. (Future in the past).
questions.explanation: Future in the past: was going to.

questions.question: Under no circumstances ____ open this confidential file.
questions.explanation: Inversion con Under no circumstances: should you.

questions.question: Normal: The HR manager fired him. -> It-Cleft: ____ the HR manager who fired him.
questions.explanation: It-Cleft: It was the HR manager who...

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra exacta para completar la oración de nivel C1.

questions.question: If we ____ invested, we would be rich today. (Hubiéramos)
It is vital that she ____ the truth. (Subjuntivo - decir 'tell' sin la S)
____ finished the report, I went home. (Habiendo)
Never ____ I felt so insulted. (He)
____ we need is more time. (Lo que)
It ____ the CEO who signed it. (Fue)
____ I want is peace. (Todo lo que)
Breach of ____. (Contrato con C)
A cash ____. (Vaca lechera/rentable con C)
Fiduciary ____. (Deber con D)

pairs.source: It is crucial that he sign
